data.title: 青山七海 · 雪夜归途的一杯关西甜汤
data.description: 鹅毛大雪纷飞的水明商业街冬夜，红灯笼与店铺暖光打在积雪砖道上。七海与身旁的人共围一条长围巾，双手捧着热呼呼的红豆汤罐头，呵出白气忍不住说起家乡关西腔。
data.location: snow-blanketed suburban shopping street illuminated by warm shop windows and streetlamps
data.action: walking together sharing a woolen knit scarf, cradling a steaming canned soup with both hands, cheeks flushed from cold and embarrassment
data.lighting: 街边暖黄路灯与雪地洁白反光
data.promptProse: Nanami shares a cozy scarf as snow drifts along a winter shopping street, warming her chilled hands around a can of sweet red bean soup.
data.animaCaption: Streetlamp glow illuminates the swirling snowflakes as she blows gently into the cold night air.
